title: Red House, Tuen Mun

terrainReference.basis: Original field southeast of the veranda and outside the measured building.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named Hung Lau building footprint
mapIdentity.scope: The existing two-storey Hung Lau in the February 2017 description, including the southeast verandah and attached two-storey rear kitchen and storeroom.

note: The named native footprint and the original grade set the massing. The heritage appraisal identifies the pitched two-unit house, double verandah, pierced block balustrade and rear service annex.
